description: For any subsets A and B and any ideal I, the class of A is below the class of B exactly when A minus B belongs to I.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.quotient_le_iff.{u} {α : Type u} (I : Order.Ideal (Set α)) (A B : Set α) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I A ≤ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I B ↔ A \ B ∈ I
